notices: Theatre listings update automatically every Wednesday from NTGent, VIERNULVIER, CAMPO, Kopergietery, Arca, Opera Ballet Vlaanderen (Ghent dates), De Centrale, Theater Box and amateur theatre within 25 km (OPENDOEK). Not yet included: Minard, De Expeditie, Zebrastraat, Wintercircus, Theater Taptoe, Poppentheater Pierke and Capitole.
Sphinx closes for renovation from March 2027 for about 18 months; a pop-up cinema is planned.
Funding for theatre, music and talks: unknown until a source (credits, Kunstendecreet database) is found.
Ciné Rio, Kopergietery, Masereelfonds, Liberas and some poetry events list dates without start times; check the event page.
Talks outside Ghent are included (Antwerp, Brussels, Bruges, Sint-Niklaas and more): use the city filter.
Exhibitions: temporary exhibitions from archives, heritage institutes and museums in and around Ghent (Antwerp included), shown while they run. Opening hours differ per house; check the page.

Talks: debates, lectures, research and poetry evenings in Ghent, Brussels and Antwerp (plus earlier sources elsewhere in Flanders). Each organiser has a fiche with what it is tied to and who funds it, from its own site; otherwise 'unknown'. Party study centres were searched with the same effort for every party; none had public events that could be read (most block automatic reading).
